title: Deep holes of projective Reed–Solomon codes beyond redundancy four: recursive carriers and exact classifications through redundancy ten
description: This preprint classifies projective Reed–Solomon split-free syndrome directions from redundancy five through ten and obtains deep-hole classifications wherever the covering-radius gate is available. Coherent polar contraction proves that, for every redundancy r≥6, the reduced recursively contained locus is exactly the catalecticant rank-two scheme plus one maximal adjacent-zero Lucas carrier. Fixed-level packages give exact deep-hole classifications at redundancies eight, nine, and ten for q≥43,53,59; a final-pair Artin–Schreier argument makes the full degree-nine Lucas carrier shallow over every F_{2^m}, m≥4. Replayable certificates and conditional Lean interfaces have explicit claim boundaries.
